name: Systra Tools
tagline: Production-ready React and Tailwind UI for coding agents
description: Systra Tools gives AI coding agents a growing library of production-ready React and Tailwind UI sections, elements and templates. Search for components and pull implementation code directly into your workflow. Free components work without an API key; optional Premium access unlocks the wider library.

install.notes: Free components work without a key. To access Premium components, create a key at https://systra.tools/mcp.
